title: Early or late
goal: Say what you and others do as a rule with the general present -Ar.

intro.text: The general present is the stem + `-Ar`, or just *-r* after a vowel, + the endings you know from `-ýAr`: *içerin* (I drink), *okar* (she reads), *işläris* (we work). It says what someone does as a rule: *Men adatça ir turaryn*, I usually get up early.

vocab.en: to wash (yourself), to have a wash

exercises.question: Which is the general present of *içmek* for **I**?

why.1: *içýärin* is the `-ýAr` present. The general present is *iç-* + *-er*.
why.2: The ending for **I** is *-in*, as in *gelýärin*: *içerin*.
why.3: The tense vowel is *a* or *e*, never *i*: *iç-* + *-er*.

exercises.explain: The last vowel of *bişir-* is *i*, a front vowel, so *-er*: *bişirer*. The tense vowel is always *a* or *e*.

reject.why: *turdum* is the past: **I got up**. For what you do as a rule: *turaryn* (or *turýaryn*).

exercises.explain: *tur-* + *-ar* + *-yn*: *turaryn*, what you do as a rule. *Turýaryn* is right too.

accept: My father always goes to bed late.
My dad always goes to bed late.
My [father|dad] always goes to sleep late.

exercises.label: *içmek* in the general present: I drink, you drink…
exercises.explain: *iç-* + *-er*, then the endings of the `-ýAr` present: *-in, -siň, —, -is, -siňiz, -ler*.
After a vowel only *-r*, and the stem's *e* becomes *ä*: *işlä-* + *-r* = *işlär*.

exercises.question: *Merjen hemişe ir turar.* What does this say about Merjen?
options: She is getting up early now.

why.1: That would be *Merjen häzir turýar*. *turar* says what she does as a rule.

exercises.explain: *turar* is the general present, and *hemişe* is **always**: what Merjen does as a rule.

exercises.prompt: We wash and get dressed in the morning.
Aýna always reads in the evening.
exercises.explain: *oka-* ends in a vowel, so the general present is just *-r*: *okar*.

exercises.en: You always go to bed late.

reject.why: *ýatar* has back vowels, so the ending is *-syň*: *ýatarsyň*.

exercises.explain: *ýat-* + *-ar* + *-syň*: *ýatarsyň*, you go to bed (as a rule).

accept: We walk in the park on days off.
We walk around the park on days off.
We stroll (around|in) the park on days off.
We [walk|stroll] (around|in) the park [on our days off|at the weekend|on weekends|on the weekend].
[On days off|On our days off|At the weekend|On weekends|On the weekend] we [walk|stroll] (around|in) the park.

exercises.prompt: My father always gets up early.

reject.why: *turaryn* is **I get up**. For **my father**, the third person has no ending: *turar*.

exercises.explain: *tur-* + *-ar*, with no ending for **he**: *Kakam hemişe ir turar*.
